adaptive_followup.changes: Only the CatBoost global-model iteration cap and stopping patience; retain all original airport models, features, IDs, and labels.
adaptive_followup.limit: One additional model specification on each fold. No further tuning in this phase.
adaptive_followup.observed_before_declaration: All twelve initial complete-set evaluations. Both CatBoost fits selected all 3000 permitted trees and October error was still falling at the cap.
adaptive_followup.seed_plan: Keep the original six-candidate anchor selection and its two planned replicas. Do not fit additional follow-up seeds.

diagnostic_scope: Any new tail analysis uses only the intersection of the two fitting partitions. No December or hidden ranking labels. New feature or offset hypotheses require a separately declared later batch.
refit_iterations: rounded median of October-selected iterations separately for each model component and seed
seed_anchor_rule: among initial candidates improving both complete folds and the reference, minimize mean RMSE ratio to reference; refit every component of that recipe with each declared seed
selection: require at least 0.5 percent RMSE improvement on each complete fold over v3; minimize mean relative RMSE among the declared candidates and blends
